core_result: Zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 suite (21 files, 34 audited declarations + 1,330 TriadFrontier.* axiom-swept declarations, six kernels in CI run 45943918296) of elementary identities, finite certificates and formalizations of known results, alongside numerical experiments. Kernel-checked: a Koszul-Veronese moment-annihilation identity and a Pascal-type binomial identity used by a coded-PIR construction (T1a); inequalities between closed-form PIR rate expressions (T1b-T1d); a finite 12-variable integer polymatroid certificate at ratio 8/13 whose rank routines have no in-Lean correctness proof (T1e-T1j); DFT-cancellation and diagonal-determinant identities and integer moment and Renyi-type inequalities on tabulated weights (T2); exact NIST FIPS 203 Eq. (4.7) Compress_1 rounding and margins (T3d, fixed in v5.1.0 closing ERRATA L01); and known results (T3): rank 7 of the 2x2 matrix-multiplication tensor over every field, the substitution lower bound 2m^2-m for <m,m,m> (weaker than the Brockett-Dobkin bound 2m^2-1), a Schwartz-Zippel root bound, the Haemers bound, Lovasz's Theta(C_5) = sqrt(5) in integer form, and conditional conference-graph capacity bounds instantiated for P_5, P_13 and P_17. Numerical and outside Lean: interference dimension 42 and rate 10/17 for one GRS-aligned (6,3,3) design (privacy and decoding not verified), float64 decryption-failure model figures, and Bai-overhead and branchless sampler benchmarks. Release v5.1.0 closes all 12 paper/BibTeX/figure errata (A01-A12), Lean L01/L03-L06, and CI/script items S02-S04 from the 2026-11-26 statement audit while leaving L02, L07-L09 and S01 documented in ERRATA.md.
verification_boundary: All 31 headline theorems (T1a-T3l), master conjunction, concrete char-2/Fin 5/Fin 11 NonVacuity witnesses, and 9 AdversarialTests boundary tests (34 audited declarations + 1,330 TriadFrontier.* declarations swept by AuditExhaustiveAxioms.lean) are kernel-checked in zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0; the 32 comparator targets and their dependency closure passed 6 kernel checks (5 distinct implementations) via lake comparator --paranoid, plus a live negative tamper gate rejecting false mlkemCompress1 (1665 + 832) = 1 on Ubuntu CI run 45943918296 (zero sorry, zero native_decide, lake build --wfail 0 warnings, strictly within [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; T1e and T2f use [propext] alone). Transcendental 60-digit Renyi-2 curves, overflow-free Bai et al. (2018) alpha-sigma optima, trigonometric Lovasz theta(C_7) ~ 3.3177, float64 discrete-convolution DFR model estimates (no paradox or pass/fail threshold is claimed; standard ML-KEM-1024 gives 2^-176.63 in this model vs 2^-174.8 in FIPS 203 Table 1), and continuous DFT/QGTL spectra are verified in Tier-2 Python (0 ruff / 0 mypy, 25/25 pytest incl. Draft 2020-12 repo.yaml schema & 14/14 mutants), hardened C11 (87/87 unit + 1,024 fuzz, ASan/UBSan), and Eshkol dual-number AD (<2e-13, 3/3 + 7 negative guards), with 36/36 live HTTP-200 + 30/30 Crossref 0-retraction citations and dual DigiCert RFC 3161 + 3-calendar Bitcoin OTS timestamps. Explicitly affirms that P != NP & explicit circuit lower bounds (CS-001/CS-010), matrix multiplication exponent omega = 2 (CS-004), Valiant VP != VNP (CS-012), non-linear C(2,4,2,2) in [3/5, 8/13] (inequalities in 5 or more variables involving individual storage symbols are not excluded), (6,3,3) privacy/decoding & Sun-Tao-Xu-Zhang max-redundancy, general M >= 3 non-LFSR PIR capacity above Sun-Zhang when E >= KT, arbitrary T >= 3 zero-error schemes, exact Shannon capacity Theta(C_7) in [sqrt(10), theta(C_7)] (CS-CMP-012), and worst-case quantum MLWE lower bounds (CS-026/QC-042) remain completely OPEN. Claims no external peer review or external DOI; Software Heritage Save Code Now request #2699205 accepted.
